scope: All 51 mapped Musigny parcels and 16 recorded legal-entity identifiers reviewed for Tier 1, including commune edges, cadastral named areas and the #461 historical extension. The one notice-index candidate was read from its page image and rejected; no exact notice event is assigned. Producer/company research remains Tier 2. No current farmer is verified.

sources.title: EARL Domaine Philippe Girard application receipt, dossier 2021-122
sources.finding: The receipt (dossier 2021-122, EARL Domaine Philippe Girard, previous operator Domaine Roux Père et Fils) prints Chambolle-Musigny A139. The DFI retired A0139 on 9 November 1995, so a 2021 reference to it is not joined to its descendant A0301; AN37 is printed under Savigny-lès-Beaune. No Musigny parcel event is assigned.
